name: Rate Control
definition: The ability to time your movements or the movement of a piece of equipment in anticipation of changes in the speed and/or direction of a moving object or scene.

benchmark.name: Arcade Learning Environment
benchmark.metric: mean human-normalized score across 57 Atari games (%)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult population performing real-time visuomotor timing tasks. Operationalized by the ALE human baseline: a professional game tester after about 2 hours of practice per game, roughly a competent, somewhat-above-median player.

benchmark.name: Robot Air Hockey Challenge
benchmark.model_or_system: AiRLIHockey (MPC/optimal-control planner distilled via imitation learning)
benchmark.metric: mean success rate (%) over the hit, defend and prepare qualifying subtasks, evaluated in the organizers' modified (sim-to-real-perturbed) simulator
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce performing real-time interception and striking of moving objects (e.g., a typical adult playing casual air hockey, or an equipment operator timing movements to a moving target)

benchmark.name: Robot Air Hockey Challenge
benchmark.model_or_system: AiRLIHockey (sampling-based MPC combined with a learned contact planner and behavioral-cloning distillation)
benchmark.metric: Qualifying-stage aggregate score on a 0-100 scale, based on success rates across the Hit, Defend and Prepare tasks
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce performing timed interception or rate-control tasks (e.g., equipment operators, casual air hockey or table-sport players). The analogy is a typical adult controlling an air hockey mallet directly.

benchmark.name: Arcade Learning Environment
benchmark.metric: percent, mean human-normalized score (HNS) across the 57 Atari games
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce performing real-time timing and control tasks such as operators and drivers. The ALE human baseline (a professional game tester with brief practice) serves as a proxy for a typical-to-somewhat-above-typical human.

benchmark.name: Robot Air Hockey Challenge
benchmark.model_or_system: AiRLIHockey (hybrid: optimal-control/MPC policy distilled via imitation learning)
benchmark.metric: mean success rate (%) over the three qualifying sub-tasks (Hit, Defend, Prepare), simulated, 2023 protocol
benchmark.human_reference: General working-age adults performing everyday interception and timing tasks, with casual air-hockey play as the direct analogy. These are not trained robot teleoperators or competitive air-hockey players.
